// Accepted source 19ae4788f935f8d5a990d4cc56effc113956057f: coordination.ts gates and checks.ts sharedProjectKey.
const sharedProjectKey = (requirement: TaskBoard.WorkspaceRequirement, workspace: TaskBoard.WorkspaceResolution): string | null =>
    requirement.kind === 'existing_project' && !requirement.useWorktree ? `project:${requirement.projectId}`
      : requirement.kind === 'directory_path' ? `directory:${workspace.canonicalCwd}` : null;

  private async gates(operation: Document<"task-board/operation">): Promise<string[]> {
    const retained = this.store.operationGates(operation.pin.objectId);
    if (retained.length) return retained;
    const request = operation.value.request;
    if (!("taskId" in request)) {
      this.store.retainOperationGates(operation.pin.objectId, ["TaskBoard publication gate"]);
      return ["TaskBoard publication gate"];
    }
    const task = "TaskBoard publication gate " + request.taskId;
    const names = [task];
    if (request.action === 'edit' || request.action === 'start' || request.action === 'continue') {
      const previous = await this.store.read('task-board/task', {
        objectId: request.taskId, revision: request.expectedRevision,
      }, true, false, true);
      if (request.action === 'edit') {
        if (request.parentTaskId !== undefined || request.fields.category !== previous.value.fields.category)
          names.unshift('TaskBoard publication gate');
      } else {
        const key = sharedProjectKey(previous.value.fields.workspaceRequirement, request.workspace);
        if (key) names.unshift('TaskBoard workspace gate ' + hashJson({ host: request.target.hostId, key }));
      }
    }
    this.store.retainOperationGates(operation.pin.objectId, names);
    return names;
  }
